tools.title: Graphite CLI
tools.description: Graphite’s command-line tool for creating, rebasing, submitting, and syncing stacked pull requests on GitHub.

tools.title: GitHub CLI
tools.description: GitHub’s official command-line client for pull requests, issues, checks, repository creation, and authenticated API calls.

tools.title: Herdr
tools.description: Open-source terminal multiplexer built for coding agents, organizing persistent workspaces, tabs, and panes while tracking live agent state.

tools.title: Pi
tools.description: Minimal, extensible terminal coding harness by Mario Zechner with file, shell, skill, and multi-model session tools.

tools.title: Claude Code
tools.description: Anthropic’s interactive terminal coding harness that reads repositories, edits files, and runs shell commands in a live session.

tools.title: Orca
tools.description: Multi-agent development environment built around Git worktrees, orchestrated coding workers, and persistent event-driven bots.

tools.title: Hermes Agent
tools.description: Open-source persistent agent runtime by Nous Research with cross-session memory, curated skills, and chat connectors.

tools.title: Grok Bot
tools.description: xAI’s workspace bot for collaboration platforms like Slack, answering in shared threads with team memory and connected tools.

tools.title: orca linear
tools.description: Orca’s built-in Linear subcommand for reading, searching, filing, and updating Linear issues under the workspace owner’s login.

tools.title: tmux
tools.description: Classic Unix terminal multiplexer that keeps shell sessions, windows, and split panes alive in the background across disconnects.
